# France Rework - triggers for the Franc and Free France (generated by build_systems.py)

FRW_is_vichy = {
	original_tag = FRA
	NOT = { tag = FRA }
	has_country_flag = vichy_france
}

FRW_vichy_exists = {
	any_country = { FRW_is_vichy = yes }
}

FRW_vichy_holds_eq = {
	any_state = { OR = { state = 772 state = 773 state = 774 state = 775 state = 539 } owner = { FRW_is_vichy = yes } }
}

FRW_vichy_holds_aof = {
	any_state = { OR = { state = 272 state = 556 state = 557 state = 776 state = 777 state = 778 state = 779 state = 780 state = 781 state = 782 state = 786 state = 899 } owner = { FRW_is_vichy = yes } }
}

FRW_vichy_holds_afn = {
	any_state = { OR = { state = 458 state = 459 state = 460 state = 461 state = 462 state = 513 state = 514 state = 515 state = 665 } owner = { FRW_is_vichy = yes } }
}

FRW_vichy_holds_lev = {
	any_state = { is_on_continent = middle_east owner = { FRW_is_vichy = yes } }
}

FRW_vichy_holds_mad = {
	any_state = { OR = { state = 543 state = 706 state = 708 state = 713 } owner = { FRW_is_vichy = yes } }
}

FRW_vichy_holds_dji = {
	any_state = { state = 268 owner = { FRW_is_vichy = yes } }
}

FRW_vichy_holds_ind = {
	any_state = { is_on_continent = asia owner = { FRW_is_vichy = yes } }
}
